title: Machine learning predicts Tafel slopes of Pt-based nanocatalysts
summary: A database of 127 Pt-based nanocatalysts from 42 articles was built with standardized Tafel-slope extraction. ML models predicted Tafel slopes, and six newly synthesized catalysts had measured slopes closely matching predictions. Feature analysis highlighted substructure size and hetero-element ratio, and a design map led to Pt34Ni66 with a Tafel slope of 88.9 mV dec-1.
ai_technology: Machine learning models on a curated catalyst database with feature-importance analysis

evidence.tested: Six newly synthesized catalysts and Pt34Ni66.
evidence.unknown: Small database; numeric prediction errors not in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML predicted kinetics and guided the proof-of-concept design.
